info.name: Ecommerce Microservices
info.description:
End-to-end tests through the API gateway (http://localhost:8080).

HOW TO RUN: import this file AND Ecommerce-Local.postman_environment.json, select the environment 'Ecommerce Local' (top right), then right-click the collection -> Run collection (keep the folder order). Everything is chained with variables, so run folders 0 to 9 in order.

Prerequisite: infrastructure and all services are running (see SETUP.md).

item.name: 0. Health checks (run these first)
item.description: Quick check that the gateway answers. Eureka dashboard: http://localhost:8761

request.description: Creates a new user. The username is generated automatically.

exec: // a new unique user name for every run

request.description: Saves the JWT in the environment variable 'token'. All user requests use it automatically.

item.name: Normal user tries to create product (403)

exec: pm.test("Only ADMIN may create products -> 403", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test("product details were added by calling product-service", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()[0].product.name).to.eql("Postman Phone"));

request.description: One call: order -> user, cart, product (stock), payment, shipping. Copy the X-Trace-Id response header and run ./scripts/trace.sh <id> to see the journey.

exec: console.log("Trace id of this purchase: " + pm.response.headers.get("X-Trace-Id") + "  ->  ./scripts/trace.sh <id>");

item.name: Internal URL through gateway is blocked (403)

exec: pm.test("/internal/** is never reachable from outside -> 403", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
